σπεκουλάτωρ , ορος, ὁ,= Lat.
A.speculator, prop. scout: but in the Roman Imperial army,
1. one of the principales or head-quarters' staff of a legionary commander or provincial governor (whose duties included the carrying out of executions), Ev.Marc. 6.27 , POxy. 1193.1
(iv A.D.), etc.
2. one of the Imperial body-guard (speculatores Augusti),= δορυφόρος, Suid.
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
